classes.definition: Utility distribution system upstream of the service point.
classes.bess_role: Grid-forming reference in grid-parallel mode; must be isolated before any islanded operation.

classes.definition: Utility-owned transformer serving the site.
classes.bess_role: Sets available fault current and service voltage that the PCS and switchgear must match.
classes.pitfall: Shown with customer ratings; it is utility-owned and its kVA/impedance must be requested.

classes.definition: Utility billing meter at the service point, bidirectional under net metering.
classes.bess_role: Point of export measurement for Rule 21 / NEM and non-export control.

classes.definition: Service-entrance rated switchboard containing the main OCPD and feeder breakers.
classes.bess_role: Usual load-side interconnection point for PV and BESS breakers; busbar method (705.12) is evaluated here.
classes.pitfall: BESS and PV breakers placed next to the main instead of at the opposite end of the busbar.

classes.definition: OCPD protecting the switchboard busbar and serving as service disconnect.
classes.bess_role: Its rating is the I_main term in the 705.12 busbar checks.

classes.definition: Switchboard or panelboard that aggregates feeders, sometimes dedicated to PV/BESS sources.
classes.bess_role: Collects PV and BESS outputs before the tie to the MS; needs its own busbar check.

classes.definition: Panelboard feeding branch circuits; MLO means main lugs only, protected by the upstream feeder breaker.
classes.bess_role: Load inside or outside the backup boundary; drives demand and runtime.

classes.definition: Panel fed from the backup (load) port of a grid-forming PCS or through an isolation device.
classes.bess_role: Defines the islanded load boundary; only its loads are served during an outage.
classes.pitfall: Assuming all MS loads are backed up when no isolation device or CLP exists.

classes.definition: Panel serving site controller, comms, metering and HVAC/aux loads of the ESS.
classes.bess_role: Control power continuity decides black-start and fault behavior; often on a UPS.

classes.definition: Customer-owned transformer changing voltage between equipment.
classes.bess_role: Matches PCS voltage to service (e.g. 208 V PCS on a 480 V service); adds grounding and fault-duty questions.

classes.definition: Transformer providing galvanic isolation and a defined grounding reference on the PCS side.
classes.bess_role: Some PCS require a grounded-wye source on their terminals; the manufacturer manual decides.

classes.definition: Inverse-time overcurrent device with poles, frame, trip and interrupting rating.
classes.bess_role: Source breaker for PCS sized at 125 percent of continuous current (705.30); bidirectional current means line/load marking matters.
classes.pitfall: Sized from kW nameplate instead of PCS datasheet continuous current, or to charge current only.

classes.definition: Single-operation overcurrent device.
classes.bess_role: Current-limiting fuses can reduce fault duty on downstream equipment.

classes.definition: Switch with fuses providing both isolation and OCP.
classes.bess_role: Common for supply-side (705.11) connections.

classes.definition: Lockable visible-break switch for isolation without OCP.
classes.bess_role: Utility-accessible or AHJ-required isolation of the ESS/PCS (705.20, 706.15).

classes.definition: Disconnecting means for the PV inverter output circuit.
classes.bess_role: Separates PV source from the BESS/MS bus for service.

classes.definition: DC-rated switch isolating battery from PCS.
classes.bess_role: Required ESS disconnecting means (706.15) when not integral; must be DC and voltage rated.
classes.pitfall: Omitted in early drafts or shown with an AC-rated switch.

classes.definition: DC-rated fuse protecting battery or PV DC circuits.
classes.bess_role: Interrupts battery fault current, which can be very high; check DC interrupting rating.

classes.definition: Device limiting transient overvoltage.
classes.bess_role: Often specified at PCS AC and DC terminals.

classes.definition: Relay with IEEE device functions tripping a breaker on voltage, frequency or reverse power.
classes.bess_role: Non-export and utility-required protection for larger interconnections.

classes.definition: Initiating device for emergency shutdown of the ESS/PCS.
classes.bess_role: Fire-code and manufacturer requirement; location and labeling reviewed by fire AHJ.

classes.definition: Interlocked switch letting backed-up loads be fed from the grid while the PCS is isolated.
classes.bess_role: Keeps the CLP energized during PCS service; only meaningful in a backup topology.

classes.definition: Device that separates the islanded system from the utility.
classes.bess_role: Mandatory before islanding; may be integral to a hybrid inverter or a separate breaker/contactor.

classes.definition: Switch transferring load between normal and alternate sources.
classes.bess_role: Alternative isolation method for generator/BESS backup.

classes.definition: Single photovoltaic module.
classes.bess_role: Voc/Isc drive DC string sizing.

classes.definition: Series-connected modules forming a PV source circuit.
classes.bess_role: 690.7 and 690.8 checks.

classes.definition: Collection of strings feeding one inverter or combiner.
classes.bess_role: Title 24 kWdc is the array STC rating, not inverter AC output.
classes.pitfall: Quoting AC kW against a kWdc code minimum.

classes.definition: Enclosure paralleling strings with fuses.
classes.bess_role: Not needed for most string/hybrid inverters with integrated inputs.

classes.definition: Module-level or array-level devices plus an initiator meeting 690.12.
classes.bess_role: Initiator location coordinated with ESS emergency shutdown signage.

classes.definition: Unidirectional DC-to-AC inverter for PV only; grid-following.
classes.bess_role: Cannot charge or discharge a battery and cannot form an island alone.
classes.pitfall: Treating a PV-only inverter as the BESS PCS.

classes.definition: Bidirectional inverter with PV and battery DC inputs, a grid port and often a backup load port with integral isolation.
classes.bess_role: Serves as PCS; backup port defines the CLP; grid port is the interconnection current.

classes.definition: Bidirectional converter between battery DC and AC.
classes.bess_role: Sets charge/discharge current used in 706.30 and the 705.12 source current.
classes.pitfall: PCS abbreviation confused with power control system (705.13).

classes.definition: Listed control function limiting current on busbars/conductors or export (705.13).
classes.bess_role: Lets a controlled setting replace nameplate current in busbar math; needs listing and locked settings.

classes.definition: Small battery-backed supply for controls and comms.
classes.bess_role: Keeps site controller and meters alive through transfer and grid loss.

classes.definition: Listed enclosure containing battery modules, BMS and sometimes PCS, thermal and fire features.
classes.bess_role: The UL 9540 listed unit; energy and power ratings, enclosure type, location and spacing come from it.
classes.pitfall: Rated energy confused with usable energy, or cabinet count left unresolved.

classes.definition: Large walk-in or non-walk-in ESS enclosure.
classes.bess_role: Triggers explosion control, deflagration and larger-scale fire review.

classes.definition: Series-connected modules forming the DC battery bus.
classes.bess_role: DC voltage window must fit PCS DC input range.

classes.definition: Assembly of cells with module-level monitoring.
classes.bess_role: Unit of 9540A module test data.

classes.definition: Single electrochemical cell.
classes.bess_role: Chemistry drives fire-code thresholds and 9540A cell data.

classes.definition: Monitors cells and commands contactors and PCS limits.
classes.bess_role: Its signals are control/sense domain, never drawn as power conductors.

classes.definition: Controller dispatching PCS charge/discharge from meter data and schedules.
classes.bess_role: Implements non-export, TOU arbitrage, demand response and backup reserve.

classes.definition: Vendor controller linking meters, PCS and cloud.
classes.bess_role: Often powered from the aux panel/UPS; needs CTs at the service.

classes.definition: Enclosure for network/cellular equipment.
classes.bess_role: Supports remote monitoring and demand-response signals.

classes.definition: Sensor producing a current proportional to conductor current.
classes.bess_role: Location and polarity at the service decide whether non-export control works.
classes.pitfall: CTs placed downstream of the PCS tie so the controller cannot see export.

classes.definition: Voltage sensing transformer.
classes.bess_role: Voltage reference for relays and revenue-grade meters.

classes.definition: Accuracy-class meter on the grid, PV or BESS circuit.
classes.bess_role: Program performance, SGIP or owner M&V data.

classes.definition: Monitoring device logging energy flows from CTs.
classes.bess_role: Evidence for demand-flexibility and performance; not a protective or revenue device.

classes.definition: Electrode connecting the system to earth.
classes.bess_role: Separately derived systems (transformers, some PCS) need their own electrode connection.

classes.definition: Conductor from system bond point to the electrode.
classes.bess_role: Location of the neutral-ground bond must stay single per derived system.

classes.definition: Conductor bonding equipment enclosures to the source.
classes.bess_role: Sized from upstream OCPD per 250.122; upsizing rules follow ungrounded conductor upsizing.

classes.definition: Conductor set of a circuit between two ports, with its own tag in the conductor schedule.
classes.bess_role: Sized from 705.28 / 706.30 then corrected for temperature, fill and voltage drop.
classes.pitfall: Conductor size not updated after the breaker was upsized.

classes.definition: Enclosure for conductors; type limited by location and exposure.
classes.bess_role: Outdoor/buried runs to the BESS pad decide type and fill.

classes.definition: Box for splices or pulling.
classes.bess_role: Transition from roof/wall to underground runs.

classes.definition: Concrete pad, wall or roof support for equipment.
classes.bess_role: Anchorage and seismic detail referenced from the plan; DSA review on schools.

classes.definition: Barrier protecting equipment from vehicles.
classes.bess_role: Fire/building code item where ESS is exposed to vehicle traffic.

classes.definition: Required warning labels and source directory.
classes.bess_role: Source location directory at service and ESS hazard markings.

layout_conventions: Read source to load in one direction per sheet: utility at left/top, loads at right/bottom. Bidirectional flow is an annotation, not a reversed symbol.
Snap every symbol hotspot and port to a 10 unit grid in Draw.io and QET.
Equipment tag nearest the symbol, then function, then verified ratings; long model data goes to the schedule.
Power solid 2 px, bus 6 px, sense dashed 1 px (4 4), control dashed 1 px (8 4), grounding dash-dot 1 px. Never merge control and power.
Existing thin grey, new black, removed dashed with X; the legend must survive monochrome printing.
Every connector has a source and target cell; no free-floating line ends on power circuits.
Layers: Power, Sense-Control, Grounding, Annotation, Frame. Cells parent to a layer, never to root 0.
Use only shapes listed in drawio_shape; anything else renders as a plain rectangle.
Reference notes by unique key (hexagon tag) instead of repeating paragraphs on the drawing.
Show listed assemblies (BESS cabinet, hybrid inverter internals) as dashed boundaries so integral vs field devices are explicit.
Declare units, origin, north and scale; dimension clearances from equipment faces, never from schematic geometry.
When the 120 percent method is used, draw source breakers at the end of the bus opposite the main.

extra_notes.template: Power control system {listed_pcs_function} limits {controlled_quantity} to {setting_value}; settings access restricted per {manual_revision}.
Loads on {critical_load_panel} are served in islanded mode through {isolation_device}; loads on {non_backed_panels} are not backed up.
